verdict.rationale: Gide has a dedicated Employee Share Schemes page stating it designs, implements and monitors employee share ownership and executive remuneration plans in France and internationally, with combined legal, tax and employment expertise. Its Executives & Management Packages page covers the French local scheme BSPCE, including 2026 tax changes. Missing for 10: any first-party mention of non-French local schemes such as UK EMI, German VSOP/ESOP or Indian ESOPs, explicit detail on option-plan structuring, and independent or client corroboration of the equity practice.
